cohort_note: BOTM-VENUE-01: a bounded, evidence-driven proof — not a claim of complete Lisbon venue coverage. Every entry here was actually referenced by one of the 19 real AgendaLX/Hot Clube Observations proven in BOTM-OBSERVATION-01/01A; see docs/VENUE_RESOLUTION.md for the venues that were investigated but deliberately left unresolved.

evidence.note: EGEAC (Empresa de Gestão de Equipamentos e Animação Cultural — Lisbon municipal cultural agency) official venue page. States the address 'Parque Mayer, 1250-096 Lisboa' and links an official 'get directions' Google Maps shortlink (https://maps.app.goo.gl/PgnLPrz43VZjvVRt8).

The exact Google Maps shortlink published on the EGEAC page above (not an address independently submitted to a geocoder). It resolves to Google's place page for 'Cineteatro Capitólio', which carries an explicit place marker coordinate pair (the URL's !3d/!4d values): latitude 38.7188712, longitude -9.1466143. The @lat,lng pair earlier in the same URL is the map *viewport* center, not the place marker, and was not used.

Official parish website for the church. States the address 'Igreja Paroquial, Largo da Graça, 1170-165 Lisboa'. No coordinates, embedded map, or outbound map link with coordinate data was found on the page within this proof's bounded search.

Official 'Sobre Nós' (About) page. States the address 'Largo de Santa Bárbara, 3D, 1150-287 Lisboa'. No coordinates, embedded map, or outbound map link with coordinate data was found on the page within this proof's bounded search.

venues.address: Rua do Grilo, 119, Beato Innovation District

evidence.note: Official Casa Capitão website (Beato, Lisboa cultural space — concerts, exhibitions, artistic residencies) states its own address: 'Rua do Grilo, 119, Beato Innovation District'. No postal code was found on the fetched page within this task's bounded search, so none is fabricated here; secondary (non-first-party) sources disagree on the exact postcode digits (1950-142/144/146 variously reported), which is exactly why this project does not treat them as address authority.
